Message.MsgText: Could not read object from storage. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: This is an internal error. An error occurred while reading an object from storage.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message.

Message.MsgText: Could not write object Java object to storage. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: This is an internal error. An error occurred while writing an object to storage.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: The storage location folder name does not exist and could not be created.

Explanation.p: The configured storage folder does not exist. An attempt to create it was unsuccessful.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the configuration is correct.

Message.MsgText: The storage location file name exists but is not a folder.

Explanation.p: The storage location must be a folder.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the configuration is correct.

Message.MsgText: Could not read the value for key key name from file file name. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: The storage file which holds the value for the specified key could not be read.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Check the file system permissions.

Message.MsgText: Could not create folders for path folder path.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism could not create file system directory structure.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the file system permissions.

Message.MsgText: file name already exists and is not a folder.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism expects that the specified file is a folder.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Could not write to file file name. The error is: exception

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism could not write data to the specified file.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Key must not be empty.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism cannot work with empty keys.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Key must not be a single slash.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to be a single slash.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Key must not be contain consecutive slashes: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain consecutive slashes.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Key must not contain back slashes: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain back slashes.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Key must not contain curly brackets: key name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a key to contain curly brackets.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Component of a key must not be a single dot: key component.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a component of a key to be a single dot.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Component of a key must not be double dots: key component.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism does not allow a component of a key to be double dots.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the configuration.

Message.MsgText: Could not delete file file name.

Explanation.p: The storage mechanism failed to delete the specified file.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the file system permissions.

Message.MsgText: No Local Server API detected.

Explanation.p: A Touchpoint Provider was configured to use the Local API, which is not present in the current runtime.

OperatorResponse.p: Configure the Touchpoint Server to use the Remote Server API instead.

Message.MsgText: Invalid host(actual host provided) or port(actual port provided) value.

Explanation.p: See error message.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide correct values in order to be able to connect to the remote server.

Message.MsgText: Error connecting to server: server name

Explanation.p: Could not establish a connection to the remote server.

OperatorResponse.p: Check that the remote Touchpoint Provider is up and running.

Message.MsgText: Missing parameter value: parameter name

Explanation.p: The Touchpoint Server configuration is missing a required parameter.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide the missing parameter value.

Message.MsgText: Could not create session to the remote server: server name

Explanation.p: See exception message.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the remote server is up and running and that the Touchpoint Server has all necessary configurations correctly set.

Message.MsgText: An error has occurred during the communication with the remote server: server name

Explanation.p: See exception message.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the Touchpoint Server configuration.

Message.MsgText: Unable to read the Stash file. Reason: underlying implementation message

Explanation.p: See the message.

OperatorResponse.p: No action necessary.

Message.MsgText: The Stash file has already been read. Using the encryption settings from the solution.properties file.
Touchpoint Server configuration is missing encryption settings. Using the encryption settings from the solution.properties file.
No encryption settings specified in solution.properties.

Explanation.p: The solution.properties is missing the encryption settings that the Touchpoint Server requires.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide encryption settings in order for the encryption of passwords to work.

Message.MsgText: Missing connector connector name not found in template path to template file

Explanation.p: The provided Touchpoint Template is missing the required connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the Touchpoint Template and make sure the connector is there.

Message.MsgText: Unable to create xml element: {element namespace}element local name

Explanation.p: See the provided exception message.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: Could not read Touchpoint Server configuration file(file name).

Explanation.p: See the provided exception message.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the specified configuration file is readable.

Message.MsgText: Missing property: tp.server.config.

Explanation.p: The path to the Touchpoint Server configuration file is not specified.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide the path to the configuration file.

Message.MsgText: Could not restore persisted state.

Explanation.p: See the provided exception message.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the persistence store is readable/writable by the Touchpoint Server application.

Message.MsgText: Missing state for Entry resource: entry resource url

Explanation.p: Expected Entry resource state to be available in the persistence store.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the persistence store is readable/writable by the Touchpoint Server application.

Message.MsgText: Missing state for Feed resource: feed resource url

Explanation.p: Expected Feed resource state to be available in the persistence store.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the persistence store is readable/writable by the Touchpoint Server application.

Message.MsgText: Touchpoint Server persistence store is disabled.
Error creating Touchpoint Provider(server name) Entry resource.

Explanation.p: The Touchpoint Server is unable to create resource based on the provided configuration.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the particular Touchpoint Provider configuration.

Message.MsgText: Missing Touchpoint Instance Client/Service Entry resource configuration data.

Explanation.p: The user has not provided the required configuration when creating Client/Service(-facing) Entry resource.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide the required configuration data.

Message.MsgText: Entry resource (entry resource url) is missing the required Touchpoint Type category.

Explanation.p: The persisted Entry resource must contain a Touchpoint Type specific category.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: The Touchpoint Type (category name) was not found on the serverserver name.

Explanation.p: The required Touchpoint Type is missing from the server.

OperatorResponse.p: Check that the type exists on the server.

Message.MsgText: Missing Touchpoint Instance Entry resource configuration data.

Explanation.p: The user has not provided the required configuration when creating a Touchpoint Instance Entry resource.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide the required configuration data.

Message.MsgText: A Touchpoint Instance with ID instance id is already present on the server.

Explanation.p: The Touchpoint Server could not restore resources with duplicate IDs.

OperatorResponse.p: See error message. Contact SyncWeave support.

Message.MsgText: A Touchpoint Instance Service/Client Entry (resource relative url) already exists.

Explanation.p: The Touchpoint Server could not create resources because one already exists.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the resource does not exist before creating it.
